Cost of warehousing is greater than cost of local delivery D. Cost of warehousing is less than cost of local delivery

Which of the following statements best illustrates the logistics value proposition? A. It is based on cost minimization or revenue maximization. B. It primarily involves transportation, planning, and execution. C. It integrates operational components to minimize total cost and maximize revenue. D.
